main.description: An artifact's bytes, from the registry's own copy — never redirected to the publisher. A deleted release still serves them. The output encoding is `*/*`, as com.atproto.sync.getBlob's is, and the media type is the one the bytes were stored under.

type.description: Which artifact: `package` is the module, `icon`, `banner` and `screenshots` are presentation assets, and a custom type carries an `x-` prefix.

errors.name: ReleaseNotFound
errors.description: No release is indexed at that version.

errors.name: ArtifactNotHeld
errors.description: The release is indexed but its bytes have not been copied yet, or that artifact type was never published.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry instance has no identity configured (HAPPYPROTO_DID), so it cannot read its own state. An operator problem, not a caller's.
